map.关于「糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）与血糖换算」: About HbA1c and Blood Glucose Conversion
map.采用 ADAG 研究公式，由 HbA1c 估算平均血糖；仅供健康管理参考，不能替: Uses the ADAG study formula to estimate average glucose from HbA1c; for health-management reference only and not a substitute for finger-stick or venous glucose testing.
map.平均血糖 eAG(mg/dL) = 28.7 × HbA1c(%) − 46.7: Estimated average glucose eAG(mg/dL) = 28.7 × HbA1c(%) − 46.7 (ADAG equation); gap to control target = eAG − 154 (corresponding to the HbA1c 7.0% target). Validation: no strict validation; HbA1c defaults to 0. Interpretation: eAG < 140 normal glucose tolerance (annual recheck), 140–199 prediabetes (OGTT recheck, repeat HbA1c every 3–6 months), ≥ 200 diabetic range (endocrinology follow-up); HbA1c cutoffs 5.7% / 6.5%.
map.eAG(mmol/L) = eAG(mg/dL) ÷ 18（mg/dL → mm: eAG(mmol/L) = eAG(mg/dL) ÷ 18 (fixed conversion divisor 18 for mg/dL → mmol/L). Validation: no separate validation; the mmol/L value is converted in step with the mg/dL result. Interpretation: grading (< 140 normal / 140–199 prediabetes / ≥ 200 diabetic range) is given on the mg/dL scale; mmol/L is for comparison with SI-unit readings.
map.由 HbA1c 按 ADAG 公式估算平均血糖（eAG），并按 HbA1c 切点: Estimate average glucose (eAG) from HbA1c with the ADAG formula and interpret it against HbA1c cutoffs; this page does not provide direct mg/dL↔mmol/L conversion.
map.采用 ADAG 研究公式，由 HbA1c 估算平均血糖（本页估算）；贫血、血红蛋: Uses the ADAG formula to estimate average glucose from HbA1c (estimate only). Anemia, hemoglobinopathies, dialysis, etc. can distort HbA1c; the result cannot replace venous glucose monitoring or diagnosis and requires clinical review.
